# RICE prioritisation (Mohit Aggarwal)

Scores and ranks backlog items with the RICE framework.

- Source: https://github.com/mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills/main/skills/rice-prioritisation/SKILL.md
- Author: Mohit Aggarwal
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/rice-prioritisation-mohit-aggarwal-b8beff04

Claude scores each initiative on reach, impact, confidence and effort, then returns a ranked table with quick wins and moonshots flagged, dependency notes and a suggested order. A bundled script can calculate scores from JSON or CSV input. It includes definitions to adapt, a scoring rubric, quality checks and anti-patterns.

**Try asking:**
- "Prioritise these 12 backlog items with RICE"
- "Score our Q3 initiatives and suggest a sequence"
- "Here's a CSV of features with estimates. Rank them by RICE"
